about_desc:
In the 1990s, a group of mathematicians and cryptographers asked a simple question: could we create an environment where information would remain unchanged forever? A place where no one could rewrite history, falsify facts, or erase what had already been said? They created the blockchain — a digital ledger where every page is linked to the one before it, so that if you try to tear out a single page, the entire chain is broken. It was the first technology to give us something more than a way to store data. It gave us the power to leave a trace that cannot be erased.

 Years later, Bitcoin emerged from this technology, followed by thousands of other projects. The blockchain became a noisy marketplace — a tool for money, speculation, and endless consumption. But that was never its original purpose. So we are bringing the blockchain back to what it was meant to be.

 Manuscript Project is a digital archive of ideas designed to live forever. Every thought recorded here becomes part of history. Imagine that one hundred, or even five hundred years from now, our descendants will be able to open this archive and discover what people at the beginning of the 21st century were thinking about. Just as we uncover the artifacts of ancient civilizations today, they will uncover our ideas. This is a bridge between us and the future — and at the same time, a map of the steps we can take to improve our Planet and life upon it.

 Humanity stands on the threshold of a new era. We have entered a new millennium, and the choices we make today will shape the future of our civilization. We can continue the endless race for possessions, status, and approval. Or we can take a step forward and start building something new, something real, something that truly matters. We are not here to fight the existing system. We are creating an alternative: a space where value is measured not by how much you paid, but by the mark you leave behind.

 Here, every idea carries weight. The more people support it — with likes, attention, and belief — the more significant it becomes. This helps us see what deserves our attention and where our resources should go first. An idea embraced by others is no longer just a thought. It becomes a movement. And it can begin becoming reality today. When you create a manuscript, you receive a token. When people like your idea, the number of tokens grows. The token becomes more than a coin — it becomes a measure of your contribution to our shared future. A resource that can turn an idea into action.

 Human beings are the highest form of life on Earth. We possess a consciousness capable of changing reality, yet we have forgotten its power. We have a collective unconscious, but we have long since stopped using it. We are buried beneath other people's scripts and endless to-do lists, selling our time while following values we once chose for ourselves, but no longer remember why. We chase goals that are no longer truly ours. We have forgotten that thinking is an action. That every thought shapes the world around us. That collective consciousness has the power to create reality in the very moment we focus it.

 Imagine eight billion people focusing their thoughts on a single point at the same time. Like an orchestra without a conductor, where everyone hears the same melody and joins in at exactly the right moment. Manuscript Project is a tool capable of revealing the idea that deserves the world's attention first. Likes become more than ratings — they become signals pointing us toward where our collective attention should go. This is how we can improve the world step by step, focusing the power of collective intention on one challenge at a time, again and again.

 The old truths: do not kill, do not steal, do not deceive, help others, create beauty. We are bringing them back in a new Web3 context — not as religious dogmas, but as the ethics of a new world. This is not about faith. It is about the choices each of us makes every day.

 Your idea could become humanity's next step. Record it on the blockchain. Leave your mark on history. Become part of something eternal. We do not know what the world will look like a hundred years from now. But we know one thing for certain: ideas shape the future, and they can begin becoming reality today.

 Join us. The world is waiting for your thoughts.

 Together, we are humanity's next step!

info_desc:
We are building a decentralized platform where every idea is permanently linked to its author and recorded as an immutable entry on the blockchain. This intellectual capital is your contribution to humanity's collective intelligence, preserved forever. Your idea becomes part of a global chain of solutions, not just another piece of text on the internet. Together, we are shaping humanity's future. Every thought recorded on the blockchain becomes a building block in the foundation of a new world.

This is Web3, where the value of every user is defined by their contribution to the common good. Your idea could become humanity's next breakthrough. Record it on the blockchain. Start today!
idea_1_text: Smart budget allocation. In the center of every city, a monitor shows residents voting through an app on where resources are most needed at that moment
idea_2_text: Cities should plant edible fruit varieties instead of ordinary trees and shrubs. Earth is a wonderful garden! Switching to electricity and moving away from gasoline will improve the environment, and you could eat everything while walking)
idea_3_text: Collect all the plastic covering the planet, carefully melt it, and make a huge sculpture as a reminder of the dirty era. Burning it is not an option: there would be too many emissions.
idea_4_text: Introduce a 100-volt standard for all residential areas. It is much safer during accidents and reduces conversion losses.
idea_5_text: Cars with a 100% recycling rate. Stop creating landfills: every part must enter a new cycle.
idea_6_text: We need night-time pothole-finding bots: small rovers that find cracks in the asphalt and repair them while the city sleeps.
idea_7_text: Smart road markings: roads should light up and change lanes depending on traffic.
idea_8_text: Project Helios: an orbital network of mirrors to control the planet's climate. We will make the weather predictable.
idea_9_text: The planet's resource base should belong to everyone. If a person finds a mineral, that mineral belongs to them.
idea_10_text: Take the best laws that genuinely benefit people from every country, combine them into one system, and create one country for everyone by removing artificial borders. Planet Earth is home to Earthlings. Simple)
